questions.q_en: How does your photometer read OD600 without taking a sample?
questions.q_zh: 你們的光度計怎麼在不抽樣的情況下讀 OD600？
questions.a_en: An amber 600 nm LED shines through a 2 mm flow cuvette in the loop. A 90:10 beam splitter sends 10% of the light to a reference sensor, and OD600 comes from the sample-to-reference ratio, multiplied by 5 to match a 1 cm path. Against the BioDrop on TiO₂ the raw output sat a median 3.8% apart with no correction. It logged 434 hours without drawing a sample.
questions.a_zh: 一顆 600 nm 琥珀色 LED 照過循環管路上 2 mm 的流動槽。90:10 分光鏡把 10% 的光送到參考感測器，OD600 由樣品與參考的比值算出，再乘以 5 換成 1 cm 光徑。在 TiO₂ 上，未經校正的原始輸出與 BioDrop 的中位差距為 3.8%。它連續記錄了 434 小時，沒有抽任何樣品。
questions.trap_en: Forgetting to say the readings are scaled from a 2 mm path to 1 cm.
questions.trap_zh: 忘了說讀值是從 2 mm 光徑換算成 1 cm。
questions.basis: judge pattern: how does the instrument work

questions.q_en: Why 600 nm, and why do you need a reference beam?
questions.q_zh: 為什麼選 600 nm？為什麼需要參考光束？
questions.a_en: 600 nm is the standard for OD600, so readings compare with the BioDrop and published curves, and at that wavelength a culture mainly scatters light. Amber also sits between the CcaS green and red response regions, so the photometer's own light does not switch production. The reference beam sees the LED alone, so slow LED drift cancels in the ratio instead of looking like growth.
questions.a_zh: 600 nm 是 OD600 的標準波長，所以讀值可以和 BioDrop 及已發表的生長曲線比較，而且在這個波長菌液主要是散射光線。琥珀色也剛好落在 CcaS 綠光與紅光反應區之間，所以光度計自己的光不會誘導或關閉生產。參考光束只看 LED 本身，因此 LED 的緩慢漂移會在比值中抵消，不會被誤認為生長。
questions.trap_en: Saying 600 nm is chosen only because everyone uses it. The CcaSR overlap is the project-specific reason.
questions.trap_zh: 只說因為大家都用 600 nm。與 CcaSR 光譜不重疊才是專案特有的理由。
questions.basis: judge pattern: why this wavelength and sensor

questions.q_en: How do you know your photometer is accurate, and against what?
questions.q_zh: 你們怎麼知道光度計準不準？拿什麼當對照？
questions.a_en: We compared it with a BioDrop on two particle standards. On TiO₂ the raw output was a median 3.8% from the BioDrop, inside the 10% we set beforehand. On silica up to OD 1 the slope was 1.001, but the Pro read about 0.12 OD low, and the slope is 0.93 with the blank included. These are non-living particles; we have no plate-count calibration on cells, and the working limit is about OD 2.5.
questions.a_zh: 我們用兩種顆粒標準品和 BioDrop 比對。TiO₂ 上原始輸出與 BioDrop 的中位差距為 3.8%，在事先設定的 10% 之內。矽球在 OD 1 以內斜率是 1.001，但 Pro 整體低約 0.12 OD，把空白點算進去斜率是 0.93。這些都是非活體顆粒，我們還沒有用菌落計數對細胞做校正，工作上限約 OD 2.5。
questions.trap_en: Quoting R² alone. The constant offset and the missing cell-based calibration matter more.
questions.trap_zh: 只講 R²。固定偏差和沒有細胞校正更重要。

questions.q_en: What went wrong in your 434-hour photometer run?
questions.q_zh: 你們 434 小時的光度計運轉出了什麼問題？
questions.a_en: The first 240 hours or so read as a clean growth curve. After that the reference channel failed, around when the recirculation pump was replaced, and noise rose five to tenfold, so we do not read that stretch as growth. A later reanalysis found the reference sat near 32 sensor counts, so single-count steps made OD jump; 91.5% of readings were whole integers. We added two bubble gates afterwards.
questions.a_zh: 前面約 240 小時可以當成乾淨的生長曲線。之後參考通道故障，時間大約是更換循環幫浦的時候，雜訊增加五到十倍，所以那一段我們不當作生長來解讀。事後重新分析發現參考感測器只在約 32 個計數附近，單一計數的跳動就讓 OD 出現階梯，91.5% 的讀值都是整數。之後我們加了兩道氣泡閘門。
questions.trap_en: Saying the whole 434 hours is a valid growth curve.
questions.trap_zh: 說整段 434 小時都是有效的生長曲線。
questions.basis: honesty probe: what failed in the flagship run

questions.q_en: How does your Slim photometer compare with the Pro and with a commercial spectrophotometer?
questions.q_zh: 你們的 Slim 光度計和 Pro、和商用分光光度計相比如何？
kw_zh: 較線性但讀值約五分之一
questions.a_en: The Slim uses two optical fibers instead of a lens and beam splitter, so it costs US$235.29 against US$371.78 and stands about a quarter of the Pro's height. On silica it was more linear, R² 0.992 against 0.974, but it reads about a fifth as high, so you multiply by 5.57. That was one silica run, not yet repeated on culture. The BioDrop costs about US$470 and cannot sit in the loop.
questions.a_zh: Slim 用兩條光纖取代透鏡和分光鏡，所以成本是 US$235.29，Pro 是 US$371.78，高度約為 Pro 的四分之一。在矽球上它比較線性，R² 0.992 對 0.974，但讀值只有約五分之一，要乘上 5.57。這只是一次矽球實驗，還沒在細胞培養上重複。BioDrop 約 US$470，而且無法放進循環管路。
questions.trap_en: Saying the Slim is better. It trades sensitivity and has not been run long-term.
questions.trap_zh: 說 Slim 比較好。它犧牲了靈敏度，也還沒做過長時間運轉。
questions.basis: judge pattern: cheaper build versus commercial

questions.q_en: You say the leaf sensor reads 1.2 to 1.9 °C warm. How was that tested, and can a farmer trust it?
questions.q_zh: 你們說葉片感測器讀值偏高 1.2 至 1.9 °C，是怎麼測的？農民可以信任它嗎？
questions.a_en: It was tested only on a bench, in air, with no leaf: 540 paired readings against an SHT31 air sensor at three sites on 10 October. The offsets were +1.71, +1.31 and +0.47 °C, so the 1.2 to 1.9 summary leaves out the +0.47 site, and the offset drifted between runs. The wetness channel read 0.0% because it was never wetted. No threshold can be set yet; it needs a site correction first.
questions.a_zh: 只在桌上、空氣中、沒有葉片的情況下測過：10 月 10 日在三個地點，用 SHT31 空氣感測器做了 540 組成對讀值。偏差分別是 +1.71、+1.31、+0.47 °C，所以「1.2 至 1.9」的摘要漏掉了 +0.47 的地點，而且偏差在不同次測量間還會漂移。濕度通道讀 0.0%，因為從來沒有沾濕過。目前還不能設定閾值，要先做各地點的校正。
questions.trap_en: Repeating 1.2 to 1.9 as one fixed offset. The sites ranged from +0.47 to +1.71 and runs from −0.09 to +1.86.
questions.basis: validate: bench test versus field claim

questions.q_en: Have you shown that your LPA light intensities give different gene expression, and what light dose is it?
questions.q_zh: 你們有證明 LPA 的不同光強度會造成不同的基因表現嗎？光劑量到底是多少？
kw_zh: 只有 lux、沒有光子通量
questions.a_en: The LPA page says we have not yet run the intensity test the array was built for. Results has early Western blots at 2%, 12% and 100% green, and they did not order by intensity; red at full power was not silent. Light is reported only in lux, never photon flux. Matched green groups sit only about 3% apart, so PWM sets the levels, at 220, 510 and 3850 lux on the plate map.
questions.a_zh: LPA 頁面寫明，這個陣列原本要做的強度測試還沒有進行。結果頁有 2%、12%、100% 綠光的早期 Western blot，但結果不依強度排序，全功率紅光也不是沒有訊號。光只用 lux 報告，沒有光子通量。配對後各組綠光只差約 3%，所以強度層級靠 PWM 設定，培養盤圖上是 220、510、3850 lux。
questions.trap_en: Saying the LPA proved graded light response. The wiki says it has not.
questions.trap_zh: 說 LPA 已證明光強度有梯度反應。wiki 說還沒有。
questions.basis: validate: claim versus the page's own caveat

questions.q_en: What wavelengths are your green and red LEDs, exactly?
questions.q_zh: 你們綠光和紅光 LED 的波長到底是多少？
questions.a_en: We do not have one confirmed answer. Home says 520 nm green and 660 nm red, other pages say about 535 and 670, and Results says 525 and 630, and that our red LEDs emit at 640 nm, short of the 672 nm CcaS needs to switch off. The LPA page gives no wavelength, and Development lists verifying the real wavelengths as future work. So the numbers are literature values, not our measurement.
questions.a_zh: 我們沒有一個確認過的答案。首頁寫綠光 520 nm、紅光 660 nm，其他頁寫約 535 和 670，結果頁寫 525 和 630，並說我們的紅光 LED 實際發光約 640 nm，比 CcaS 關閉所需的 672 nm 短。LPA 頁面沒有給波長，開發頁把驗證真實波長列為未來工作。所以這些是文獻數值，不是我們的量測。
questions.trap_en: Quoting one pair of numbers. Judges can find the other pages.
questions.trap_zh: 只報一組數字。評審找得到其他頁面。
questions.basis: cross-page conflict on a basic specification

questions.q_en: Is your green-light control actually running in the bioreactor?
questions.q_zh: 你們的綠光控制真的有在反應器裡運作嗎？
questions.a_en: No. Green-light induction was tested on the LPA only. Every integrated bioreactor run used a constitutive promoter, so light control was out of those tests, and the Digital Twin labels green light as tested, not integrated. A 3 m green LED strip is on the rig specification, but it never induced a culture. On the LPA, green and red gave similar ELISA values, so light control itself is not yet shown.
questions.a_zh: 沒有。綠光誘導只在 LPA 上測過。每一次整合反應器運轉都用組成型啟動子，所以光控制不在那些測試裡，數位孿生也把綠光標為「測過但未整合」。規格表有一條 3 m 的綠光 LED 燈帶，但它從未誘導過任何培養。在 LPA 上，綠光與紅光的 ELISA 數值相近，所以光控制本身也還沒被證明。
questions.trap_en: Presenting the pipeline slide as if the light already switches the reactor.
questions.trap_zh: 把流程圖講得好像光已經在控制反應器。
questions.basis: honesty probe: pipeline versus what is joined up

questions.q_en: How did the LPA connect to your digital twin?
questions.q_zh: LPA 和你們的數位孿生是怎麼連起來的？
questions.a_en: The 19 September LPA run gave a logistic growth fit, r = 0.299 per hour and K = 1.005, and the twin uses it as a growth prior, though light leaked between wells in that run. Leaving each arm out in turn, its 24 h OD was forecast within 7% with the prior and 29 to 68% off without it. A rate registered on 1 October, 0.2986, met Digital Twin run 6 at 0.286, inside the interval.
questions.a_zh: 9 月 19 日 LPA 的運轉得到 logistic 生長擬合，r = 0.299 每小時、K = 1.005，數位孿生拿它當生長先驗，不過那次運轉光線有在孔間外漏。把每一組輪流拿掉，用前 8 小時預測 24 小時 OD，有先驗時誤差在 7% 內，沒有先驗則差 29 至 68%。10 月 1 日登記的速率 0.2986，與數位孿生第 6 次運轉的 0.286 相比，落在區間之內。
questions.trap_en: Skipping that the prior comes from a run where light leaked between wells.
questions.trap_zh: 沒提到這個先驗來自光線外漏的那次運轉。
questions.basis: integrate: model and lab, like Munich 2025

questions.q_en: How does your floating hydroponic plate work?
questions.q_zh: 你們的浮動水耕板是怎麼運作的？
questions.a_en: It floats on 42.27 cm³ of sealed air in two pontoons, so seedling roots stay at one depth while the medium level falls. Thirteen seedlings sit in 16 printed PLA pieces that clip together without glue, about US$1.80 of filament. By calculation it sinks about 1 mm for every 3.5 g. It sits in a 1000 µL pipette-tip box with a black box over the lower half to keep light off the medium.
questions.a_zh: 它靠兩個浮筒裡共 42.27 cm³ 的密封空氣浮起，所以培養液下降時幼苗的根仍維持同一深度。13 株幼苗放在由 16 個列印 PLA 零件組成、免膠卡合的板上，耗材約 US$1.80。計算上每增加約 3.5 g 下沉約 1 mm。它放在 1000 µL 吸管尖盒中，下半部再套一個黑盒避免培養液照光。
questions.trap_en: Giving the freeboard as a measured value.
questions.basis: judge pattern: how does the hardware work

questions.q_en: How do you know the plate floats at the height you calculated, and did your plant experiments use it?
questions.q_zh: 你們怎麼知道浮板的高度和計算一樣？植物實驗有用它嗎？
questions.a_en: We do not know yet. The 4.8 mm freeboard at 71.3 g is computed from the STL files, and no one has measured the freeboard of a printed plate. The CH Bio peptide salt pre-tests ran in these boxes with one plate per arm, so treatments could not be ranked. After several failed plantings in the boxes, the later protectant runs moved to tube racks, where Arabidopsis grew better.
questions.a_zh: 目前還不知道。71.3 g 時 4.8 mm 的乾舷是由 STL 檔計算而來，還沒有人量過實際列印浮板的乾舷。CH Bio 胜肽的鹽逆境前測是在這些盒子裡做的，每個處理只有一塊板，所以無法排出處理的優劣。盒子裡幾次種植失敗後，後來的保護物實驗改用試管架，阿拉伯芥長得比較好。
questions.trap_en: Saying the plate carried all the plant experiments. The later protectant runs used tube racks.
questions.trap_zh: 說所有植物實驗都用這塊浮板。後來的保護物實驗用的是試管架。
questions.basis: validate: design prediction versus a measurement
